Definition: from G2596 and G2480; to overpower:--prevail (against).
BiblicalUsage: Katischyo means to overpower, to prevail against. Matthew 16:18 says the gates of hell shall not prevail against the church Christ builds. Luke 21:36 tells us to watch and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things, and to stand before the Son of man. Luke 23:23 shows the other side: the voices of the chief priests prevailed, and Jesus was crucified.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe prevailing is the promise and the warning both: hell will not prevail against the church, but loud voices can prevail against one man for an hour. I hold that the church stands because Christ builds it, not because the world stops shouting.
